purpose: 用固定拓扑和固定像素合同批量生产几十种主题的可拼接战场地块，避免每个主题重新设计边缘与交付流程。

topology.rotation_policy: directional pieces are authored per direction; runtime rotation is forbidden for any piece with light, facade, wear or shadow direction
topology.assembly_rule: one gameplay cell is covered by exactly 2x2 surface tiles; a board edge row replaces the outer tile with the matching directional piece, whose 16x16 walkable part aligns to the tile grid and whose 8 px facade overhangs outside the board without changing the logical or hit footprint; no board-wide baked texture; adjacency is resolved by layout coordinates

locked_invariants.footprint: the full 16x16 ground tile canvas is one ground subgrid cell; four of them make one 32x32 walkable gameplay cell
locked_invariants.perimeter: surface pieces do not bake a repeated dark cell frame; the shared tactical-grid layer supplies visible cell boundaries, while material seams remain sparse internal features
locked_invariants.illumination: 资产不含任何场景光照：不烘焙光斑、地面投影、暗角或边缘变暗；场景光与影全部由运行时 URP 2D Light2D 负责
locked_invariants.form_shading: 资产只保留体积明暗：固定的左上方向一处，顶面亮、正面暗，用来让实体读成立体；这是形状语言而不是光照，且每个主题每块都一致
locked_invariants.value_hierarchy: center surface low contrast; border and collision silhouette readable; gameplay overlays remain highest contrast
locked_invariants.density: three to five connected material clusters plus at most two controlled wear cues; no high-frequency dither or isolated noise; dominant material tone at least 45 percent, typically 50 to 70
locked_invariants.palette: neutral material base first; cyan only for active aether; rust red only for hostile or damage semantics; safety yellow only for service, warning or loot
locked_invariants.single_native_source: one 16 PPU native asset per piece, displayed at integer tiers only, canonical 6x at 1920x1080 (6 screen px per native px); no separate resolution companion
locked_invariants.uniform_pixel_size: ground tiles, directional edges, props, structures and units must all render at the same screen pixels per native pixel in one battle view; a 16 px ground tile therefore occupies 96 screen units while a 32 px prop or unit occupies 192
locked_invariants.directional_edge_identity: the top 16x16 is the approved theme surface copied exactly; only the exterior facade overhang is independently generated and normalized, preventing a material jump on the boundary row
locked_invariants.ground_window_normalization: an opaque ground-material source may decode to a larger stable logical field; the deterministic centered 16x16 window, or a recorded phase-aligned window origin when needed to avoid clipping a regular brick rhythm, is the formal surface delivery. It records logical bounds and source hash and may neither resize, interpolate, paint, add colours nor alter any selected logical pixel. For a regular repeating brick/material field whose repetition makes the generic non-repeating-subject confidence ambiguous, a reviewer may declare the observed square macro-pixel pitch; this path remains REVIEW_READY and requires explicit human pixel-scale, material and application approval before FORMAL_CANDIDATE
locked_invariants.grid_layer: a shared 1-native-pixel tactical-grid overlay supplies visible cell edges at every integer tier; it is not baked into ground materials and has no terrain, collision or selection semantics

prompt_contract.prefix: single isolated battlefield floor piece for a near-modern aether-industrial tactical map; orthographic top-down; one ground tile only
required: flat even illumination with no directional scene light, no cast shadow and no edge darkening
fixed upper-left form shading on raised material only
visibly coarse pixel art with large connected clusters

production_gates.name: theme_lock
production_gates.rule: freeze theme parameters and one reference tile before batch generation

production_gates.name: source
production_gates.rule: one independent image-model generation per formal surface or facade; directional-edge delivery composes the approved surface top with the independently generated facade overhang and records both component sources and hashes

production_gates.name: normalize
production_gates.rule: decode the material lattice without geometric resizing; a stable opaque field may yield its recorded centered 16x16 logical window without changing selected pixels; deliver surfaces at 16x16 and directional outer edges at 16x24 with 8 px facade overhang; hard alpha, limited palette, Point/Clamp/Full Rect

production_gates.name: batch_contact
production_gates.rule: review 1x, 6x, grayscale, checker and a randomized 12x9 assembly contact before Unity

production_gates.name: human_style
production_gates.rule: reject the whole theme batch if the reference tile breaks seam, illumination, form-shading or value invariants

production_gates.name: runtime_contact
production_gates.rule: verify 1920x1080 at the canonical 6x tier using the same native asset with an integer scale only, and run Tools/OCCArt/verify_runtime_pixel_grid.py on the capture: the detected lattice must be the expected integer tier with zero offset, and ground, props, structures and units must share one pixel size; no board texture

production_gates.name: promotion
production_gates.rule: only after stable GUID, verified importer (Point / Full Rect / no compression / no mipmaps), lattice check and runtime evidence may a piece become FORMAL

rework_policy.regenerate_scope: regenerate only the rejected piece unless it violates a locked theme invariant; invariant failure invalidates the full theme batch
never: do not generate a full board as a production source
do not rotate directional pieces at runtime
do not create a new border grammar per theme
do not use palette reduction to hide noisy structure
do not resize, interpolate, repaint or synthesize the selected ground window
do not bake scene lighting or shadow into any piece
